_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] の発掘者 Placardus と話す (B 地点の欠片が必要)

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#001.dst: 全作業正常…輸送は予定通り…ああ。君か。探していたよ。
WynnExcavation Site C#001.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#002.dst: 君を見つけるのは思ったよりはるかに難しかったが、自分からここへ来てくれたね。
WynnExcavation Site C#002.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#003.dst: 来てくれたはいいが、何と言えばいいか。だが説明すべきだろう。我々 WynnExcavation はこれまでの衝突すべてを謝罪する。
WynnExcavation Site C#003.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#004.dst: 最初からすれ違っていたのだ。我々は Gavel の会社で、神秘的に重要な歴史的遺物を専門にしている。
WynnExcavation Site C#004.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#005.dst: {p} での一件の後、我々は当然、君が遺物の欠片を盗んで金にしようとする闇商人だと考えた。
WynnExcavation Site C#005.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#006.dst: そこで全拠点の社員に、何としても君を阻むよう指示した。歴史的遺物の損失は重大な問題だ。これほど強大な物ならなおさらだ。
WynnExcavation Site C#006.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#007.dst: だが地方での君の旅の話を聞いて、何が起きたか理解した。君は我々を敵と誤解したのだ。もちろんそんなことはない。
WynnExcavation Site C#007.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#008.dst: これで誤解が解け、互いに別の道を行けるといい。では失礼、会議に出なければならない。
WynnExcavation Site C#008.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#009.dst: 発掘会議に潜入する。会議はダイヤのツルハシの部屋で行われ、ポータルは大きな溶岩洞窟の入口の左にある。

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#010.dst: すみません。非公開の会議です。
WynnExcavation Site C#010.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#011.dst: 今日が初日なので、通行証なしでは通せません。すみません。
WynnExcavation Site C#011.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#012.dst: 扉はまもなく施錠されます。
WynnExcavation Site C#012.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#013.dst: WynnExcavation の計画を盗み聞きする

WynnExcavation Site C#014.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#014.dst: ようこそ、Wynn Excavation C 地点の幹部諸君。闇の眼差しが永遠に我らを見守らんことを。これまでの進捗を報告する。火の遺物の水晶は長年、火山の中心でほぼ無傷のまま眠っていた。
WynnExcavation Site C#014.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#015.dst: 取り出せば連鎖反応が起き、厄介なことになるだろう。幸い、海の向こうから来た魔術師がそれを抑える。近いうちに運び出し、非公開の場所へ輸送できる見込みだ。
WynnExcavation Site C#015.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#016.dst: また、B 地点と A 地点で奪われた水晶はまだ回収できていない。だが犯人はもう我々の活動に関心を持たないはずだ。失った水晶は原初の魔力を宿しておらず、計画全体に不可欠ではない。
WynnExcavation Site C#016.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#017.dst: 当面の目標は、火山の中心から機材を運び出し、隠された場所で同化させるため火の石の輸送を始めることだ。幹部は各自の区画に責任を持て。効率よく、内密に進めよう。
WynnExcavation Site C#017.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#019.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#019.dst: 警報が鳴った！侵入者がいる！衛兵、捕らえろ！
WynnExcavation Site C#019.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#020.dst: WynnExcavation の衛兵から逃れる

WynnExcavation Site C#021.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor
WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: 辺りを探索し、裏切り者を探す

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: 君。奴らが警戒しているのは君だな。

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: 私は Amadel、反乱の指導者だ。

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: 突然なのはわかっているが、聞いてほしい情報がある。
WynnExcavation Site C#024.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: 君が聞かされたことはすべて嘘だ。Wynn Excavation という「会社」は見た目通りではない。
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: あれは隠れ蓑で、奴らの手は私の知る以上に広く及んでいる。
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: 奴らより上の権力はない、王たちでさえ。そしてその意図は良いものではない。
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: 奴らが求めるのは究極の力。数百年にわたり様々な文明が Wynn 各地に隠してきた力だ。
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: それを聞きつけた奴らは当然、この地方を完全に支配するための何かを作ろうと材料を集め始めた。
WynnExcavation Site C#029.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.dst: 私はしばらく前から目をつけられている。ここではすべて話せないが、まずは他の時と同じように水晶の欠片を集めてくれ。それが肝心だ。
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: 水晶は基地の先、火山のすぐ内側の洞窟にある。急げ、今は全員が持ち場を離れていて、火山の中心への洞窟は手薄だ。素早く動け、幸運を。
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#033.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard
WynnExcavation Site C#033.dst: 水晶の欠片を持って火山から脱出する

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: [Red Crystal Shard] を持って発掘者 Placardus に報告する

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: 丁寧に言ったのだから、素直に従えなかったのかね？
WynnExcavation Site C#035.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: 嗅ぎ回って、理解の及ばぬことに首を突っ込まずにはいられなかったか。まあいい。どうやら収穫もあったようだ。
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: 君は Amadel と話しているところを見られた。君のおかげで彼が裏切り者だとわかったよ。目はどこにでもある、若き英雄よ。
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#038.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#038.dst: 賭けてもいい、彼はもう幹部に…始末されている。
WynnExcavation Site C#038.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: 君が何も知らずに動いていることもわかった。水晶のこともその力も知らず、君の持つ水晶が我々の計画にとって取るに足らないことも知らない。
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#040.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#040.dst: 死んでいないだけ幸運だ。ここまで潜り込めたのも、この地方の新たな英雄のビギナーズラックにすぎん。
WynnExcavation Site C#040.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#041.dst: 衛兵が来て Amadel と同じ運命をたどる前に、立ち去ることを勧める。我々の力に限りはない。軍も資源も、王家さえも味方だ。我らの眼差しは常にある。さあ、目の前から消えろ！
WynnExcavation Site C#041.speaker: Excavator Placardus
